text.description_html:
RK International CK-9311, Raised Beading Cabinet Knob

The Rustic Square Cabinet Knob is a great example of how a little daring can go a long way. The holes in its design grant this knob a rustic feel, perfect for shabby chic decor. And while we think this knob will look great in almost any setting, the distressed copper finish (pictured) seems to bring out a wild-side to this knob--making it a great finishing touch to homes with jungle decor or those who decorate with a lot of animal prints. No matter how you choose to use it, this square cabinet knob breathes life into its surroundings for a truly beautiful over-all look.

Also Available: Matching Rustic Half-Round Cabinet Knob RKI-CK-9315

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-9311 Distressed Square Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-1/4" square
  • Projection: 1-5/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
